name: hop-quest-v2
description: Hop Quest — original run-and-jump platformer with a customizable hero.

scripts.app:web: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html peerjs.min.js manifest.webmanifest icon.svg sw.js www/
scripts.app:sync: npm run app:web && npx cap sync
scripts.app:ios: npm run app:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.app:android: npm run app:sync && npx cap open android
